prompt_summary: Lily in a white royal wedding gown with lace sleeves and a long veil, small silver tiara, hair in soft curls, nervous but beautiful expression.
Lily in the same light-blue dress but torn and muddy at the hem, bare dirty feet, messy hair with leaves, small scratches on arms, scared expression.
Lily about 8 months pregnant, still young (22) and beautiful, wearing an oversized brown flannel shirt over a long plain skirt, hair in a loose braid, soft hopeful expression, hands on her belly.

Lily as a young mother, still looks 23 (she never ages in this story): the exact same sweet, innocent, beautiful face, no wrinkles, no pregnancy, honey-blonde hair in a loose messy bun, red-and-black flannel shirt, jeans, work boots, warm gentle smile, a little braver look.
A newborn white baby Bigfoot, fluffy snow-white fur, pale-pink face, big blue eyes, tiny hands, cute and innocent, wrapped in an old patchwork quilt.
Frost as a 5-foot playful kid Bigfoot, snow-white fur, big blue eyes, curious happy face, small black crescent patch on chest.
Frost as an 8-foot teenage Bigfoot, leaner muscles, snow-white fur, first faint silver scale patterns on shoulders, energetic look.

Adult Frost after the power ritual: glowing electric-blue tribal tattoos on his arms, chest and face, eyes glowing blue, small blue lightning sparks around his hands, fur slightly brighter silver, fierce warrior expression.
Bruno as a translucent glowing blue spirit in the sky, soft light, peaceful smile.
Prince Damian in black spiked armor with a red cape and a long silver sword.
King Magnus in full black iron battle armor riding on the back of the red dragon.
Tommy Miller grown up, about 22: tall, lean young American man, messy brown hair, light freckles, friendly grin, red baseball cap, plaid flannel shirt, jeans, boots.
Sarah Miller grown up, about 19: young American woman, long blonde hair in a side braid, kind brave eyes, denim jacket over a yellow top, jeans, boots.
Grace Carter years later, about 62: white hair in a bun, deeper wrinkles, kind tired eyes, the same faded floral apron over a simple dress, wooden cane.
